title: Generate a downloadable ZIP build artifact for the deployed application

requirements.text: Add a repeatable build-and-package workflow that produces a single downloadable ZIP artifact of the current application, including both backend and frontend build outputs and minimal deployment instructions.

quotes: Everything is built and deployed — would you like me to prepare the downloadable ZIP for you now?

acceptanceCriteria: Running the packaging workflow outputs exactly one ZIP file (e.g., in a dedicated /dist or /artifacts folder) without manual steps beyond invoking the workflow.
The ZIP contains backend build outputs needed to deploy the canister(s) (e.g., wasm + candid/interface files as produced by the normal build).
The ZIP contains the frontend production build output (static assets) as produced by the normal frontend build.
The ZIP includes a short README (English) with steps to deploy locally using dfx, including any environment/setup prerequisites.
If packaging fails, the workflow prints a clear, actionable error message identifying the failed step (backend build, frontend build, or zipping).

requirements.text: Add a lightweight "Download ZIP" build artifact entry-point for developers/operators (English text) that makes it easy to locate and retrieve the generated ZIP file after a successful build.

quotes: would you like me to prepare the downloadable ZIP for you now?

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful build/package run, the location and filename of the generated ZIP are printed clearly to the console/log output.
There is a single documented command (in English) to generate the ZIP from a clean checkout, suitable for re-trying if a prior attempt failed.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if state schema changes require it.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts.
nonGoals: Do not add new product features to the ERP (inventory/sales/customers/etc.) beyond enabling ZIP artifact generation.
Do not introduce external databases, cloud build services, or third-party authentication providers.
